changes: Canonical runtime identity is now proof-or-stop: state lives under .proof-or-stop, config is proof-or-stop.config.json with deprecated lattice.config.json still readable, packages/main publishes as @proof-or-stop/core, and bin/lattice.js plus bin/lattice-codex.js are gone. Global CLI discovery prefers the proof-or-stop bin on login PATH. The last source fix isolated the Codex heartbeat timeout smoke from a real global shim by pointing HOME at an empty temp dir so sh -lc cannot steal the fake CLI.
usage: From a story worktree run node bin/proof-or-stop.js --version and node bin/proof-or-stop.js verify_codex --storyId=<id> --heartbeatTimeoutMs=180000 --heartbeatTimeoutReason="<why session_brief needs longer>". New projects write proof-or-stop.config.json; old lattice.config.json still loads with a stderr deprecation notice. Do not invoke bin/lattice.js.
expectedOutcome: proof-or-stop --version prints 0.3.261; verify_codex reports 8/8 pass including global-fallback heartbeat; validate --story=B-cc10 --json reports allPass true and 24/24 verification coverage; serial-reference exits 0; node bin/lattice.js is not a working entrypoint.
actualTranscript: verify_codex: Codex adapter checks passed (8/8 pass) with heartbeatTimeoutMs=180000. validate reused PASS, Verification intent coverage 24/24 covered. npm run test:serial-reference ended with ProofStory acceptance rollout smoke PASS (58 assertions) at HEAD cebf0e195f. story_advance TEST succeeded with CLI gate preflight all pass. delivery_check_set: 14 docsPromises verified, 8 realMachineTests, no unverified. node packages/main/dist/tasks/codex-heartbeat-timeout-smoke.js printed the PASS_LINE after HOME isolation.
outcomeDiff: No difference: expected CLI identity, heartbeat timeout pin, serial-reference, validate coverage, TEST advance, and delivery-check all matched the actual transcripts.
limitations: none — fully covered. Frozen identities were not renamed: integrity salts, lattice-* role IDs, and root package.json name lattice stay. Historical .lattice mentions in CHANGELOG and archived stories were not exhaustively rewritten. Review-assurance 3x2 host quorum is still a TEST-to-DONE floor for this high-risk story and is recorded separately from the product identity migration.
pitfalls: REVIEW-to-TEST died twice: first the 15-minute CLI max watchdog killed validate at quorum-submit-smoke; raise PROOF_OR_STOP_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS. Second, validate commands all passed but persistence failed because process-events.jsonl was already dirty from verify_codex. Commit adapter evidence before validate persist, or persist cannot write test-evidence. The heartbeat smoke failed when ~/.local/bin/proof-or-stop existed because resolveGlobalCliCommandPath uses sh -lc (login PATH) and ignored PATH prepend; isolate HOME in the smoke, do not drop login-shell discovery. serial-reference failed under an exported LATTICE_SESSION_ID because delivery-context-pack-smoke expected a foreign-owner exception. english-artifacts rejected CJK in commit messages. Gate-repeat freeze required a PTY story_resume without --takeover.
